submission.natural_language_explanation: Open-bracket depth counter, weighted by bracket kind: fires on tokens that follow a still-unclosed '(' or '[' (one open round bracket about 0.35-0.45 of max, one open square bracket about 0.3; each further nested '(' or '[' adds roughly 0.2-0.25, reaching 0.75-1.0 at three or more), while curly braces '{' and angle brackets '<' add only weakly (alone about 0.05-0.2 of max, below the active line; brace-delimited code blocks and JSON objects with string keys read near zero). It reads near zero outside brackets, on an opener that is not itself inside another bracket, inside plain quotes, and on and right after any closing bracket (even when an outer bracket is still open, the tokens just after an inner close drop sharply); it tracks bracket characters, so it also fires inside comments and prose parentheticals.
